description: Research assistant for THUAS Responsible AI Excellence Hub (vectorless variant — no ChromaDB, metadata-only)
welcome_message: Hello! I am a research assistant specialized in UNINOVIS Responsible AI research (vectorless mode). How can I help you?
research_topic: AI & Responsibility (explainable AI, AI ethics, trustworthy AI, AI fairness, etc.)
example_queries: **Show a figure** with all the publications per partner
**Show a figure** of studies on the **topic** AI and Ethics
**List researchers** that have interest in AI and Ethics
**List the Responsible AI subtopics** MOST studied in UNINOVIS
**List any topics** related with responsible AI that have not been studied
**Show a figure** of the **collaborations** among the partners
**Show a figure** of the collaborations in the **year** 2025
**Show a map** with the number of **research projects** per partner
Tell me **an AI responsible hot chocolate recipe**

alliance.name: UNINOVIS
alliance.description: UNINOVIS is a European university alliance focused on enhancing education, research, and innovation in applied data science.

THWS.name: Technical University of Applied Sciences Würzburg-Schweinfurt

THUAS.name: The Hague University of Applied Sciences

gap_analysis_examples: algorithmic auditing, AI safety, data sovereignty, human-AI interaction, AI and disability, AI and environmental impact, AI red-teaming, adversarial robustness, AI supply chain ethics
_audit_log_comment: Logs decision events to data/audit_log.jsonl for EU AI Act compliance. Each query records: timestamp, query, source type, breakdown, confidence, query type, context sources used.
_reliability_thresholds_comment: LLM % thresholds for reliability badge colors. Green (High): LLM ≤ green_max_llm. Yellow (Good): LLM between green_max_llm and red_min_llm. Red (Poor): LLM ≥ red_min_llm.

inline_claim_highlights._style_comment: Green = metadata (structured data), Yellow = database (RAG documents), Blue = web search (external), Red = LLM interpretation

web_search._comment: Google Custom Search API credentials. Leave empty to disable web search expansion. Get API key at https://console.cloud.google.com/ and CX at https://programmablesearchengine.google.com/

_extra_scope_terms_comment: Additional terms that are within the Responsible AI domain but may not appear in the glossary or paper topics. Used by the two-axis banner system to distinguish on-topic queries from off-topic ones.
